name: ConfirmationModal
description: Reusable confirmation dialog for destructive or important actions. Supports optional type-to-confirm for high-risk operations like cascading deletes.
usage: Use for any destructive action (delete, remove, cancel)
Use type-to-confirm (requireConfirmText) for cascading deletes or irreversible actions
Simple confirm/cancel is sufficient for single-item deletions
Supports async onConfirm handlers with automatic loading state
Close modal on success, keep open on error for retry opportunity
design: Uses Modal component for consistent overlay and animation
Danger variant uses red confirm button for visual warning
Type-to-confirm input is case-sensitive and disables button until matched
Loading state shown on confirm button during async operations
Cancel button uses ghost variant for secondary action
Compact size (sm) appropriate for confirmation dialogs
accessibility: Uses Modal's built-in focus trap and escape key handling
Confirm button clearly disabled until conditions met
TextInput has descriptive label for type-to-confirm

props.name: onClose
props.description: Called when modal is closed (cancel or backdrop click).

props.name: onConfirm
props.description: Called when user confirms. Can be async - modal handles loading state.

props.name: message
props.description: Message explaining what will happen on confirmation.

props.name: variant
props.description: Visual variant indicating severity. Affects confirm button color.

props.name: requireConfirmText
props.description: If set, user must type this exact text to enable confirm button. Case-sensitive.

props.name: loading
props.description: External loading state (merged with internal async loading).
